task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to head south. Okay, and then, make an effort to move west. That done, go south. Once you do that, move east. And then, make an attempt to venture south. Then, go to the south. Then, go to the east. After that, attempt to go north. After that, make an effort to move east. Following that, move north. With that done, attempt to take a trip north. And then, make an attempt to take a trip west. After that, go north. With that done, try to head west. With that done, head west. Then, retrieve the coin from the floor of the steam room. That's it!
